metadata.format_note: Imported from DILA's 瑜伽師地論資料庫 standalone 科判 download, T1605-kp.txt (R04 F9, F25; tests/fixtures/dila-ybh/README.md): UTF-8 without BOM, one node per line, indentation of two ASCII spaces per level, label = depth letter (A=level 1, B=2, … Z=26, then a=27 …) + sibling number, a space, then the heading; a hyphenated sibling range in the label (e.g. 'H4-5') marks one node standing for several of DILA's original siblings, flagged merged_range (0 such node(s) here). A trailing full-width '（分<Chinese numeral>）' gives the number of children DILA's outline announces for that node (child_count_announced; 917 of 2605 nodes here carry one); it disagrees with the number of children actually present in 7 of them, each flagged count_mismatch (warning-level, scripts/validate_outline.py [child-count]). Depth is taken from the label's letter, cross-checked against the line's indentation; the two agree on every line of this file (checked 2026-09-22), so no node here is flagged irregular_label. The standalone -kp.txt carries no Taishō line anchors (R04 F25/F9): every node's locations.scheme is 'none' and every node carries flag 'unmapped'. In this gold's outline_mode 'sutra', scripts/validate_outline.py's [sutra-span-unmapped] rule requires exactly this for every sutra-span node without a cbeta-kepan root span (module docstring) — the flag is not merely documentary here.
metadata.origin_note: Every node is origin 'imported' from DILA's standalone T1605-kp.txt and unchecked against T1605's own CBETA text (structure only: no Taishō line anchors are read or resolved here). DILA's own composite per-node provenance labels (【韓科】/【倫科】 etc., R04 F3, F10, F28) are carried in DILA's internal TEI, not in this plain-text export, and are not reconstructed here.
